docs.summary: The public entry point: compiles GLSL source text into a SPIR-V module. Pipeline is parse (with preprocessor) -> lower -> serialize. The optional defines dictionary selects shader variants; the target selects the SPIR-V version and defaults to 1.0. The optional includes callback resolves `#include` directives; without it, an include is a compile error.

docs.summary: Runs only the preprocessor. Returns the preprocessed GLSL text and the state it found (version, extensions, pragmas, defines, and included files), so a host can lay out a program before compiling it.
